capture.title: Used Kona e-bike conversion listing
capture.text: 48V 750W Bafang conversion on a used Kona. Seller wants $350 and says the battery is healthy, but does not give its age or a recent range test. I might pick it up after work. Compare it with the other bikes I saved and make sure I remember to ask about battery age, charger, and proof of purchase.

context.user_goal_hint: avoid another bad purchase while keeping the process quick
